name: Delivery Order Restriction
description:
This app allows managers to restrict access to delivery orders (DO) for certain users. The manager can assign 
        rights to specific users to hide particular orders from view based on the "DO restrict" setting in the transfer view.

        Features:
        - Users view: Admin can assign the "DO restrict Manager" role to a user, allowing them to manage which orders are restricted.
        - Transfer view: Delivery orders with the "DO restrict" boolean checked will be hidden from users who do not have "DO restrict Manager" rights.

name: PO Creation Restriction
description:
The Purchase Order Create Restriction module gives you control over which users or user groups are allowed to create purchase orders in Odoo. It ensures that only authorized procurement staff or purchase managers can initiate POs—reducing unauthorized purchases and strengthening internal procurement policies.

Ideal for companies that require centralized or permission-based purchasing workflows.
